title: dashboard.overview.gpu.list
description: GPU list across every vendor the cluster carries. NVIDIA cards come from HAMI (/hami/api/vgpu/v1/gpus); Intel and AMD cards come from KubeSphere monitoring, because HAMI only enumerates CUDA devices and never returns them. Which exporters are queried is decided by the per-mode node labels (gpu.bytetrade.io/nvidia, /nvidia-gb10, /intel-gpu, /amd-gpu, plus the older /cuda-supported for NVIDIA). `items[i].display` carries the same string columns for every vendor so the table stays one table: vendor, gpu_id, model, mode, host_node, health, core_util, vram_total, vram_used, vram_usage, power, temperature — a column the vendor cannot report is '-' rather than 0 (Intel publishes no temperature, and only HAMI has a sharing mode). `items[i].raw` is vendor-shaped: HAMI's full GPU object verbatim for NVIDIA (uuid, type, shareMode, nodeName, nodeUid, health, coreUtilizedPercent, coreUsed, coreTotal, memoryUsed, memoryUtilized, memoryTotal, memoryUtilizedPercent, vgpuUsed, vgpuTotal, power, powerLimit, temperature; NB HAMI returns the list at the TOP LEVEL, not inside a `data` envelope), and the joined device row for Intel/AMD (vendor, uuid, nodeName, type, deviceId, deviceNode, rowKey, health, healthReason, plus that vendor's own readings). The GPU subtree mirrors the SPA: detail pages do NOT hard-block on admin role or GPU labels (only the sidebar card is hidden). When the SPA would have hidden the card, the CLI populates meta.note with the advisory ('GPU sidebar entry is hidden for non-admin profiles…' or 'no node carries a gpu.bytetrade.io/* mode label…') and proceeds anyway. A vendor that fails while another answers becomes a `meta.warnings` entry rather than an error, so one broken exporter cannot blank out the cards beside it. Empty envelopes carry one of these reasons: 'no_vgpu_integration' (HAMI 404 and no other vendor present), 'vgpu_unavailable' (HAMI 5xx — meta.error carries the upstream message, meta.http_status the status), or 'no_gpu_detected' (no vendor returned a card).

error.description: Upstream HAMI error message when empty_reason='vgpu_unavailable'

http_status.description: Upstream HTTP status when the SPA would have surfaced a non-200

note.description: Advisory hint mirroring SPA's sidebar gate (non-admin / no GPU node) or the HAMI-down explanation

warnings.description: One entry per vendor that failed while another answered, prefixed by the vendor ('intel: …', 'hami: …'). Present only on a partial answer; the items array still carries every card that did resolve.
